title: Storage Consistency Guardian: Terraform module to validate & enforce EBS/EFS/S3 encryption + snapshot hygiene
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Create a new reusable Terraform module (storage-consistency-guardian) that wraps EBS/EFS/S3 provisioning with operational safeguards: default encryption enforcement (KMS-backed), snapshot lifecycle policies with immutable tagging, preflight validations for cross-account and cross-region snapshot sharing, and optional Lambda-driven automated remedial actions. The goal is to give Private (VPC) deployments a single module that prevents common misconfigurations, enables safe upgrades of storage primitives, and wires lightweight health checks and alerting hooks into our Console observability. Will support both resource creation and a migration path to bring existing unencrypted/untagged volumes/buckets into compliance without data loss.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published under modules/storage-consistency-guardian with documented inputs/outputs and examples for EBS/EFS/S3
Module enforces encryption-by-default using customer KMS key passthrough and rejects plans that attempt to create unencrypted volumes/buckets unless explicitly allowed via a flag
Snapshot lifecycle policy template included with tagging rules and retention; migrations include a documented, tested plan (dry-run) to create encrypted copies and rotate traffic
Preflight validation plan implemented as a terraform-null_resource / local-exec hook that verifies IAM permissions and cross-account snapshot visibility before apply
Automated health checks: CloudWatch metric filters + Lambda remediation for missing tags or expired snapshots (opt-in), with alerts surfaced to Console via existing webhook integration
Module has unit/integration tests (terratest) covering create/update/destroy and a recorded e2e run against a test VPC in staging
Documentation (Confluence) and a how-to migration runbook are published and linked from README
Security review completed and findings tracked; module passed KMS key usage and audit logging checks
comments: 2026-02-16 - Initial scoping: decided to unify EBS/EFS/S3 patterns into one opinionated module rather than three separate modules to reduce duplication. Trade-off: slightly larger module surface but easier to maintain consistent policies.

2026-02-20 - Architecture review with Security: KMS passthrough accepted; must support both customer-managed CMKs and Redwood-managed fallback keys. Security requires audit log hooks and a toggle to disable automated remediation for high-compliance customers.

2026-02-25 - Engineering sync: agreed on implementation plan: (1) core terraform resource wrappers, (2) migration helper using snapshot-copy approach, (3) health-check lambda packaged separately and referenced as module optional resource.

2026-03-01 - Spike results: terratest runs for EBS snapshot copy across regions show ~1.2x latency than naive copy due to multi-part snapshot; will add exponential backoff and chunked copy to reduce throttling on large volumes.
2026-03-04 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5468. Requesting review from @ops-team and @security. Draft README with examples for non-destructive migration included.

2026-03-06 - Code review feedback: @ops-team asks to add feature flag for automated deletion of orphan snapshots; security asks to ensure the module never disables bucket versioning by default. Addressed in latest commit.

2026-03-09 - Integration test in staging passed for S3 bucket encryption enforcement and snapshot tagging; EFS test partially blocked by quota in staging, follow-up ticket created to increase quota (ENG-98312).
2026-03-10 - Preparing runbook and notifying Solutions Engineering for early adopter customers planning Private deployments next quarter. Scheduling security review next week.
